messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view. Use the provided camera reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video, then follow the described high-angle front three-quarter camera setup and movement. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use the video that was the input to the first clothing change as the starting point, and make the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then raises both arms overhead in a stretching motion, turns her body slightly, and returns to a standing pose.","camera":"A static, full-body, eye-level shot from a slightly elevated angle.","clothing":"A grey and white patterned sleeveless crop top, high-waisted teal trousers, brown strappy sandals, and a thin black choker.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Short blue hair with straight bangs and a small low ponytail at the back.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, dark skin, and a short face with bangs.","scene":"An outdoor industrial area with cracked concrete ground, scattered rocks, a pile of wooden planks, and large copper pipes in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the character from the front in a full-body, slightly elevated/high-angle view in an industrial outdoor scene, matching the reference framing. The character performs the same arm-raising stretch sequence and returns to a standing pose.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view, matching the reference framing while preserving the character, clothing, action, scene, and timing.
unexpected_changes: The scene changed from a waterfront platform to an industrial area with wooden planks and copper pipes, although this matches the provided camera reference.
